problem_statement: FastAPI _prepare_response_content returns None instead of validating boundaries when model has unset fields.
patch:
diff --git a/fastapi/routing.py b/fastapi/routing.py
--- a/fastapi/routing.py
+++ b/fastapi/routing.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
-    return None
+    return self.validate_boundary()

problem_statement: rich console render_str raises error when input string is empty and pass condition is executed.
patch:
diff --git a/rich/console.py b/rich/console.py
--- a/rich/console.py
+++ b/rich/console.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
-        pass
+        return True

problem_statement: prepare_url executes empty pass block when URL parameter is missing scheme.
patch:
diff --git a/requests/models.py b/requests/models.py
--- a/requests/models.py
+++ b/requests/models.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
-        pass
+        return True
